units.source_text: B对自己的机智有点自鸣得意。

en.t: B felt a little smug about his own cleverness.

units.source_text: 可是，我接触到这个问题，就觉得很难过。

en.t: But whenever I touched on this question, I felt terribly distressed.

units.source_text: 凭借夜间积雪反射的光亮，我望了望自己的手。

en.t: By the light reflected from the snow at night, I looked down at my own hands.

units.source_text: 这里有我那狡猾的卑屈。

en.t: There was my own cunning servility in this.

units.source_text: 我的衬衫袖口直耷拉到双手的半截手掌处。

en.t: The cuffs of my shirt hung straight down halfway over the palms of both hands.
The cold was, of course, one reason,

units.source_text: 不过更重要的，是我不想让姑娘的父亲看见自己过分瘦削的胳膊。

en.t: but more importantly, I did not want the girl's father to see my excessively thin arms.

units.source_text: 我暗自高兴，与这位父亲会面是在层层套着臃肿棉袄的隆冬季节。

en.t: I was secretly glad that my meeting with this father took place in the depths of winter, when I was bundled in layer after layer of bulky padded clothing.
